model: TUDOR Black Bay 41 M7941A1A0NU-0001 (41 mm steel, black dial, black coin-edge bezel, riveted three-column steel bracelet)
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Black Bay 41 template (config/watches/tudor-bb41-*; step pipeline/steps/watch_tudor_bb41.py, a copy of watch_tudor_bb58.py used with a three-column bracelet): case, bezel (insert + coin edge), crown, hands (same artwork as the Black Bay 58 in px, so profiles = Black Bay 58 mm x 13.8718 / 13.7268) and the outer / centre / outer bracelet from the 41 mm photo; the dial, indices, print and minute track come from one 2x photo map with the photographed hands left in it.

case.note: integrated lugs: the case outline follows the photo silhouette (lug tops y 287 / bottoms y 934.5); top slopes toward the bracelet

bezel.note: steel coin-edge ring (insert_out..bezel_out) around the black insert (bezel_in..insert_out); numerals, markers and triangle come from the projected photo

hands.note: profile = [mm along the hand from the pivot (negative = tail), half width] from tail to tip, copied from the Black Bay 58 profiles (the photo shows the same hands in px: hour stem half width 10.5-10.8 px, diamond +-32 px at 84 px, nub end 121 px, seconds discs r 7 / 12 at 68 / 103 px) and scaled x 13.8718 / 13.7268 (carries the 0.03 mm margin) so the 3D hands hide the photographed ones; the last point sits at the traced length. lume = +w side outline [s, w] of the lume polygon, mirrored about the axis (hour: stem strip + snowflake diamond with the nub, minute: strip to a point, seconds: disc). Hands and hub use the hands_photo material (the reference photo projected from the front)

crown.note: no crown guards; fluted part to x 768, rounded end cap to 775 (24 flutes visible over the 7.5 mm height)

strap.note: strap.bracelet.columns lists the column kinds left to right; bounds_x_mm holds one boundary less; pieces_mm has top / bottom [y0, y1] chains per kind

bracelet.note: Flat bracelet of three columns (outer / centre / outer, riveted look) with the joints read from the photo with brightness scans (x 350 / 450 / 550, +-8 px wide) and 3x crops, top and bottom separately, mm from the pivot (13.7268 px/mm, pivot (451, 610)): outer top joint y 162.5, outer bottom 1049; centre top 253 and 131.5 (an end bar from y 131.5 to the end 118), centre bottom 974 and 1080.5; ends y 118 / 1123 (the last pieces stop 0.05 mm short). Vertical joint lines (dark lines) at x 387.0 / 514.5 (top) and 386.3 / 514.2 (bottom). The centre column starts under the case (row 299 on top, 1.1 mm inside the lug end at the bottom). Rivet ears at the sides come from the alpha silhouette.

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass
